scope: Conditional mathematical demonstrations, not empirical forecasts. The two primary modules are separate and uncalibrated. The one-state feedback extension is only a counterexample; none constitute a solved full economic-information equilibrium.
dependencies: Python standard library and Pillow; no LLM or API calls.

contest_module.assumptions: Risk-neutral identical independent economic decision-makers; simultaneous effort choice; proportional contest success W*e_i/sum(e); linear effort cost; fixed active-operator cost. Multiple threads or agents controlled by the same decision-maker are not independent economic competitors and their combined effort belongs to that operator. Rival effort is positive for N>=2. Entry test evaluates the post-entry symmetric equilibrium, not transient entry dynamics.

unit_convention.N: independent economic decision-makers, not agent threads

contest_module.verification: Golden-section numerical maximization of unilateral payoff against fixed equilibrium rivals; +/-10% effort deviations; accounting identity.

information_module.assumptions: A and v are exogenous constants. H and B have linear dynamics with assumed endogenous noise amplification. B denotes noisy, redundant or unreliable stock, not all AI-generated content. No monetary feedback or finite-capacity correction is imposed.

unit_convention.alpha_beta: stock units per time per activity index

information_module.verification: Independent RK4 integration of original ODE RHS at dt=0.01; analytic zero-rate limit and near-zero continuity.

closed_feedback_counterexample.scope: Single-state counterexample with frozen H=10 and activity reduced by pollution-related cost. It is a deliberately assumed feedback, not measured behavior, not a full coupled equilibrium.
closed_feedback_counterexample.unit_convention: x=B/H0 and q=1/(1+x) are dimensionless; H0 frozen; time uses the abstract units of the information module; activity declines as A0/(1+kappa*x).
closed_feedback_counterexample.interpretation: Fixed A=6 has a positive noise-amplification rate. Endogenous activity reduction here yields a finite, stable polluted state, disproving an unconditional divergence claim within this extension.
